metric_policy: No mean-only promotion. Tail metrics are mandatory because D2 improved local/median precision while materially worsening hard-tail p90/mean behavior.
panel_aggregation_policy: For each metric report family mean, median, p90 and p95 where finite; checkpoint selection uses explicit family hard-tail statistics, never a mean-only score.
product_threshold_policy: G0 freezes definitions, not final product thresholds. G1 establishes the family-disjoint baseline; G7 owns product qualification thresholds.

surface_evidence_semantics.P: REQUIRED common/object-frame geometric position or equivalent surface geometry
surface_evidence_semantics.Z: OPTIONAL explicit learned correspondence embedding; not required when common-frame geometry makes persistence implicit
surface_evidence_semantics.correspondence_persistence: REQUIRED semantic capability: observations across views must associate strongly enough to form coherent surface hypotheses
